dataset.name: Sen1Floods11 v1.1 Hand-Labeled Subset
dataset.citation: Bonafilia, D., Tellman, B., Anderson, T., & Issenberg, E. (2020). Sen1Floods11: A georeferenced dataset to train and test deep learning flood algorithms for Sentinel-1. CVPR Workshops.

karnataka_inference.note: No ground-truth flood labels exist for this Karnataka window. Metrics are intentionally omitted; outputs are labeled 'Model prediction (unvalidated)'.

limitations: Urban double-bounce radar reflections from dense Bengaluru buildings can mask street-level water.
Terrain radar shadow in steep Western Ghats or quarry walls can resemble dark specular water.
Domain shift between Sen1Floods11 GRD scenes and Planetary Computer Sentinel-1 RTC scenes requires dB calibration alignment.
Heavy canopy vegetation attenuates C-band SAR penetration under flooded tree cover.
